chapter: England, Paris and memories of Kansas City and Harlem
title: Florence Mills remembered
summary: Mills was a dancer and singer, in the Ziegfeld show 'Poor Little Blackbird'; she was sad when Mills died.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Was Florence Mills a dancer too?
Yes, she was a dancer and a singer.
She went to Europe, didn't she?

I don't know because see I saw her a couple of times, I met her, I went back stage with Jeanette. They were good friends, the team of Seymour and Jeanette, the lady I worked with. I wasn't in her company too much.
But what sort of an impression did she make?
A very good one. I was very unhappy when I found out she had passed away because she was so sweet you just had to fall in love with her.
But she was in the Ziegfeld show when - ?
Yes, 'Poor Little Blackbird' or something like that show, that's when I met her.
